response.sql: SELECT p.SEX, AVG(CAST(l.DNA AS REAL)) AS avg_dna, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS avg_alb_minus_tp FROM Laboratory l INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.`T-CHO` >= 180 GROUP BY p.SEX

assumptions.assumption: Laboratory.DNA contains numeric values suitable for averaging, despite being stored as TEXT in the schema; the documentation's normal range (N < 8) indicates numeric data.
